title: Knowledge state per item, derived from the kb
goal: show, next and horizon run rag.py pack (no network, no model) on each ask of an item and each of its refs, and report one state per ask or ref: sufficient (coverage good, no check line naming a false good), partial (coverage weak), unknown (coverage none), stale (a fact key no longer found, or a cited source whose superseded_by is set in _sources.csv) or conflicting (the article has an open entry in _conflicts.md); no other state exists; the state is reported, never stored, and does not change readiness. The SessionStart hook does not run pack.

gates.question: This adds a mechanism before a failure it answers has happened (backlog.md, Changing this process). Add it anyway?
